name: Clonazepam 2mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Klonopin®)
short: Clonazepam 2 mg, 30 tablets — benzodiazepine prescribed for panic disorder and certain seizure disorders. Available with prescription verification at CMC Pharmacy Cabo.
description:
Clonazepam is a long-acting benzodiazepine. Its active ingredient is clonazepam 2 mg per tablet, and this presentation contains 30 tablets. It is commonly prescribed alone or in combination with other medications to manage panic disorder and certain seizure disorders.

Like other benzodiazepines, clonazepam works on the central nervous system by modulating the GABA neurotransmitter system, producing a calming and anticonvulsant effect. Dosing must be individualized by the prescribing physician; abrupt discontinuation is not recommended. Consult your healthcare provider for proper dosing and to determine if this medication is appropriate for your condition.

Available at CMC Pharmacy Cabo with bilingual service and fast hotel delivery throughout the Cabo region. Prescription Required. A valid medical prescription is needed to dispense this medication. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1).
